model_kind: CatBoost multi-class classifier that scores each tempo-level candidate of a 8 s chroma window as on-beat, off-beat or not a beat level
runtime_decision: Embedded read-only in the DSP module and evaluated at each 2 Hz update; the class probabilities are mapped through the isotonic calibration and prior stored in g2_tables.generated.h. The weights are fixed at build time.

training_parameters.row_weights: every candidate row weighs 1; no per-source or per-track weights

training_data.early_stopping_and_calibration: one quarter of every training source (a cross-validation fold assigned by track group); the isotonic calibration tables are fitted on it

storage.policy: Split thresholds are 8-bit indices into per-feature sorted binary32 border tables, which is exact. The symmetric trees use the oblivious layout (one split per level, split k sets bit k of the leaf index), which is exact. Leaves are rounded half to even to int8 with one binary32 scale (absolute maximum / 127, rounded to binary32 first) per tree and output. Splits, tree addition order, scale and bias are unchanged.
storage.reproduce: Export the source model to a float-threshold, float-leaf heap tree (format in BUILD.md), then run python dsp/plugins/analyzer/tree_models/compact_model.py g2_level.json --oblivious --leaves int8

selection_only_sets.set: Slakh2100-redux validation split and Groove MIDI validation fold
selection_only_sets.used_for: choosing the analysis window (8 s) and the feature families

selection_only_sets.items: 105 tracks: 24 tracks of the non-public-domain Winterreise performance and 81 MusicNet recordings that are not public domain
selection_only_sets.licence_class: evaluation only: the non-public-domain audio is CC BY-NC-ND 3.0 (no modified redistribution) and the MusicNet recordings are not verified public domain
selection_only_sets.used_for: a decoding check that informed one choice: the reduced feature set (without the character family) was kept over the full set; no model was trained or fitted on it

training_exclusion: The public-domain Winterreise recordings were not used for training or fitting this artifact.
